elements.title: Time series graph generated by plt.plot(x, y)

details.trend: The values generally increase from x=1 to x=4, peaking at 9895, then decrease steadily from x=5 to x=8.

elements.summary: This line chart shows a time series dataset with x values from 1 to 8 and corresponding y values, illustrating how to plot time series data in Python using matplotlib's plot function with markers and y-axis limits.
